column1: # India, in.karachi: no state or umbrella authority found; the only verified table is
# Dawat-e-Islami's Delhi AJAX (18/18 Hanafi, elevation-adjusted; dawateislami.net, "sharing these
# default timings is not allowed", used only to fit and prove). One month, one source: fit only,
# nothing held out (as RU-DUMRT's single-town table).
# End of eating (audit of 3 Oct 2026, before Ramadan 1448): Dawat-e-Islami prints no separate sehri time; its Fajr is the
# dawn at which sehri ends, so the Fajr column is also checked as the end of eating (F+E).
# Lenient by up to 59 s (fix round of 3 Oct 2026): the AJAX source prints seconds, and the table rounds
# its Fajr UP to the minute (right for a start), so as the end of eating's reference it can stand up
# to 59 s after the authority's moment; a floored Fajr is the strict reference. No held day sits in
# that window: the end comes at least 1 min before the rounded-up Fajr on every day here, so it is
# never after the floored one either. A later capture with a day at +0 must be checked against the
# floored seconds (to-do: an E column from the source seconds rounded down, next archive round).
